Sub: Conference Call Invite for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/ Madam,  
 
In compliance with Regulation 30 read with Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform you that a conference call is scheduled to be held on 
Tuesday, November 03, 2026 at 04:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss the Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone 
& Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
 
Invite for the aforementioned conference call is enclosed herewith. 
 
This information shall also be available on the Company’s Website at www.sparkminda.com.  
 
You are requested to take the same on your records.
